title: P1 integrate blocked Outcome report refresh with exact retry ownership
rawUserRequest: Execute P1 #636 to break the #634 blocked Outcome writer ↔ #635 task-report ownership deadlock. Build independently from latest origin/main: a failing Finish must write a valid blocked Outcome and refresh the exact active Human Benefit Report pair; report-refresh failure must remain fail-closed while preserving a valid blocked Outcome; diff ownership accepts only the exact active Outcome binding; cover retry E2E; use no temporary workaround and do not push, open a PR, or merge.

checkpointPolicy.reason: P1 lifecycle correction needs an evidence-bound implementation and finish checkpoint.

acceptance: On every non-archive Finish failure after the Outcome boundary, ai-finish persists a validator-valid blocked active Outcome describing the failed gate and recovery condition.

Writing a blocked Outcome refreshes both review-phase Human Benefit Report files from that exact persisted Outcome; report refresh failure remains a Finish failure and does not remove the valid blocked Outcome.

Diff ownership accepts task_report.json and task_report.md only as a complete exact pair bound to the active Work Item's current Outcome, and rejects stale, malformed, incomplete, missing-Outcome, and cross-task pairs.
A real non-archive Finish retry after a generated blocked Outcome advances beyond diff ownership without manual staging, deletion, or report editing.
Focused tests, full quality, non-archive Finish, Outcome/report validation, and local archive are recorded truthfully; no provider mutation occurs.
guidelines: Preserve evidence over self-declaration: only a validator-valid exact Outcome binding owns generated reports.
Keep failures fail closed while retaining truthful recovery evidence.
Generate reports from persisted Outcome truth; never hand-patch derived evidence.
Use tests that exercise the real retry boundary, including negative binding cases.
Document lifecycle-visible behavior in the capability reference without overstating provider verification.

intent.problem: A failed Finish needs a blocked Outcome, but the existing active report can remain bound to a superseded Outcome. The ownership check correctly rejects the stale report before retry, producing a cycle where retry cannot reach the code that would refresh the report.
constraints: Do not rely on #634/#635/#628 uncommitted worktrees or use a temporary workaround.
Keep blocked Outcome evidence valid even when report refresh fails.
No provider mutation; do not push, PR, merge, archive remote, or release.
intent.rationale: The blocked Outcome is the authoritative recovery fact and the active Human Benefit Report is a derivative. Refreshing the derivative from the persisted fact atomically enough for retry breaks the cycle while preserving fail-closed validation.
